This ensures that the application can correctly handle incoming offers in trickle ICE mode by preventing the processing of duplicate offers from the same client.
  
- The modification in **kvsWebRTCClientViewer.c** to generate a random client ID enhances the uniqueness of client sessions, which is important for the logic in **Common.c**. By ensuring that each viewer has a different client ID, it reduces the likelihood of encountering the same client ID in the offer handling logic, thereby improving the robustness of the application against the bug that was fixed.
